proposition: A marginal note in MS Majlis 10196 says Sharḥ Ḥadīth Nabawī (f. 122a, undated) was copied from an autograph in a majmūʿa of Mawlānā Rukn al-Dīn Ṣāʿid Kirmānī; the note's author is not named and the autograph is not known to survive.

mediation.who: copyist(s) of MS Majlis 10196, as reported by Melvin-Koushki citing Ḥāʾirī's catalogue
